column1: Extraction basis: 20 Forward CSV files (Vd=0.05/1.0 V) + 10 GIDL CSV files. Vth: |Id|=1e-7 A constant-current with log interpolation. SS: log10(|Id|) linear fit over 1e-12–1e-8 A. Ioff: first Forward point at Vg≈0 (≈1e-5 V). Ion: Vg=1.0 V. GIDL: |storage TotalCurrent| at Vg=-0.4 V. Signed raw current is preserved in O08.
